charts.name: timeseries
charts.description: Lines of values over time
charts.dataShape: a time field and number fields

charts.name: barchart
charts.description: Bars of values by category or time
charts.dataShape: number fields, with a string or time field for the categories

charts.name: histogram
charts.description: Bucket counts of the values
charts.dataShape: number fields

charts.name: candlestick
charts.description: Open, high, low and close values for each time or category
charts.dataShape: number fields named open, high, low and close

charts.name: boxplot
charts.description: Five-number summary for each category
charts.dataShape: number fields named min, q1, median, q3 and max

charts.name: piechart
charts.description: Parts of a whole as slices
charts.dataShape: a number field, with a string field for the names of the parts

charts.name: funnel
charts.description: Values of the stages of a process, from largest to smallest
charts.dataShape: a number field, with a string field for the names of the stages

charts.name: heatmap
charts.description: Colored cells of values over time and buckets
charts.dataShape: heatmap cells, or a time field and number fields for the buckets

charts.name: geomap
charts.description: Points on a map
charts.dataShape: a geo field, a geohash field, or latitude and longitude fields

charts.name: state-timeline
charts.description: Changes of state over time, as bands
charts.dataShape: a time field and string, boolean or number fields

charts.name: status-history
charts.description: Status at each time, as cells
charts.dataShape: a time field and string, boolean or number fields

charts.name: nodeGraph
charts.description: Nodes and the links between them
charts.dataShape: node graph frames, or source and target fields

charts.name: sankey
charts.description: Flows between nodes, with a width for each value
charts.dataShape: source, target and value fields

charts.name: chord
charts.description: Flows between nodes on a circle
charts.dataShape: source, target and value fields

charts.name: treemap
charts.description: Nested rectangles of a hierarchy, with an area for each value
charts.dataShape: string fields for the levels and a number field

charts.name: sunburst
charts.description: Rings of a hierarchy, with an angle for each value
charts.dataShape: string fields for the levels and a number field

charts.name: radar
charts.description: Several values of each item on axes around a center
charts.dataShape: three or more number fields

charts.name: parallel
charts.description: Several values of each item as lines across parallel axes
charts.dataShape: two or more number fields

charts.name: streamgraph
charts.description: Stacked flows of values over time
charts.dataShape: a time field and number fields

charts.name: bubble
charts.description: Bubbles of values over time, with a size for each value
charts.dataShape: a time field and number fields
